Earn 40% Commission Sharing Glow Garden

Join our Glow Garden partner program and earn a generous 40% commission on every sale you refer. Glow Garden is a beautifully crafted natural skincare guide designed to help women achieve radiant, healthy skin using simple, plant-based ingredients found in the kitchen and garden. With over 300 recipes, daily rituals, weekly glow routines, and targeted treatments for every skin concern, this bestselling digital book delivers real results - making it an easy, high-converting product to promote. Share Glow Garden with your audience, help them transform their beauty routine naturally, and enjoy premium commissions with every purchase.

🌿 GLOW GARDEN AFFILIATE PROGRAM TERMS & CONDITIONS

Last Updated: December 2025

These Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions (“Agreement”) govern your participation in the Glow Garden Affiliate Program (“Program”). By registering as an affiliate, you agree to comply with and be legally bound by all terms below.

1. Enrollment in the Program

To participate, you must submit an application through our affiliate platform. We reserve the right to approve or reject any application at our sole discretion for any reason, including but not limited to brand misalignment, unsuitable content, or incomplete information.

2. Commission Structure

2.1 Commission Rate

Affiliates earn a 40% commission on all confirmed sales generated through their unique affiliate links.

2.2 Lifetime Commissions

You earn 40% commission on all future purchases made by the customer for life, as long as the customer originally entered through your affiliate link and remains tagged to you in our system.

2.3 Eligible Products

Commissions apply to all Glow Garden digital products, including but not limited to:

  • Glow Garden Main Book

  • Glow Garden Family Bonus Pack

  • Teen Glow

  • Glow Guys

  • Glow Mum & Baby

  • Any future digital upsells unless otherwise stated

Physical products, subscriptions, or third-party items may have different commission structures (if applicable).

3. Tracking & Cookie Policy

3.1 Cookie Duration

We use a 30-day cookie window.
If a customer purchases within 30 days of clicking your link, the sale credits to you.

3.2 Last Click Attribution

The commission is assigned to the most recent affiliate link clicked by the customer.

3.3 System Accuracy

Glow Garden is not responsible for:

  • Users clearing cookies

  • Browser settings blocking tracking

  • Technical issues outside our control

We only pay commissions tracked and recorded in the affiliate system.

4. Payment Terms

4.1 Payment Frequency

Commissions are paid every 7 days.

4.2 Payment Methods

Payments are made via:

  • PayPal

  • Wise

  • Bank Transfer
    (You must provide accurate payment details.)

4.3 Minimum Payout Threshold

Minimum payout is $25. Balances below this amount roll over to the next cycle.

4.4 Refunds & Chargebacks

If a customer requests a refund or performs a chargeback:

  • Any associated commission will be deducted from your next payout.

  • If insufficient balance exists, a negative balance may carry forward.

5. Affiliate Responsibilities

Affiliates agree to:

5.1 Ethical Promotion

You must promote Glow Garden truthfully and ethically. Misrepresentation of results or claims is strictly prohibited.

5.2 Brand Reputation

You may not associate Glow Garden with:

  • Offensive, illegal, or harmful content

  • Hate speech, violence, or discrimination

  • Medical misinformation

  • Adult content

5.3 Compliance With Laws

You must comply with:

  • All marketing/advertising laws

  • FTC disclosure requirements (e.g., #ad, #affiliate)

  • GDPR, CCPA, and all applicable privacy rules

5.4 Accurate Representations

You may not claim:

  • Guaranteed results

  • Medical cures

  • Unrealistic outcomes

Glow Garden is a natural wellness resource, not a medical treatment.

6. Prohibited Marketing Methods

The following are NOT allowed:

❌ Using your own affiliate link to purchase products
❌ Running paid ads using Glow Garden brand names
❌ Running retargeting ads to Glow Garden audiences
❌ Any form of spam (email, social media, messaging platforms)
❌ Fake discounts or unauthorized coupon codes
❌ Using our brand to disparage competitors
❌ Cookie stuffing or fraudulent tracking methods

Violation may result in immediate termination and loss of commissions.

7. Intellectual Property

Glow Garden grants affiliates a non-exclusive, revocable license to use:

  • Approved images

  • Logos

  • Promotional materials

You may NOT:

  • Edit or alter Glow Garden branding without approval

  • Resell, reproduce, or distribute any book or product

  • Claim ownership of Glow Garden intellectual property

All rights remain exclusively owned by Glow Garden.

8. Termination

Glow Garden may terminate this Agreement at any time, with or without cause.

Termination may occur for:

  • Fraudulent activity

  • Misuse of affiliate links

  • Brand damage

  • Failure to follow these Terms

  • Inactivity for 12+ months

Upon termination:

  • All pending unpaid commissions may be forfeited

  • Use of Glow Garden branding must cease immediately

Affiliates may also terminate their participation at any time by notifying the Glow Garden team.

9. Limitation of Liability

Glow Garden is not liable for:

  • Loss of earnings

  • System interruptions

  • Tracking failures

  • Delayed payments due to incorrect details

  • Any indirect or consequential damages

Your participation is voluntary and at your own risk.

10. Modifications to the Agreement

Glow Garden may update or modify these Terms at any time. Affiliates will be notified via email or dashboard. Continued participation constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

11. Independent Contractor Relationship

Affiliates are independent contractors, not employees or representatives.
You are responsible for your own taxes, reporting, and compliance.

12. Governing Law

These Terms shall be governed by and interpreted according to the laws of Malta

13. Acceptance of Terms

By participating in the Glow Garden Affiliate Program, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agreed to these Terms & Conditions in full.
